text.en: The taste is a little... off, I think.
I ordered a {cocktail}... this is it?

text.ko: 자리 있냐고 물었잖아. 대답 안 해?
text.en: I asked if there's a seat. No answer?
A booze peddler with an attitude...
Now THAT's a drink! Whew, I'm alive again!

text.ko: 이 맛에 돈 쓰지. 오늘 좀 괜찮은데?
text.en: This is what I pay for. Not bad tonight?

text.ko: 야, 돈 도로 뱉어. 돈 내고 이딴 건 못 마셔.
text.en: Hey, spit my money back. I'm not paying for this.
You kidding?! How am I supposed to drink this?!

text.ko: 아이 씹, 이딴 걸 술이라고 내와?
text.en: The hell — you call this booze?

text.ko: 쳐맞고 싶어서 환장했나... 맛이 왜 이래?
text.en: You asking for a beating... why does it taste like this?

text.ko: 지금 뭐 하자는 거야? 사람 안 보여?
text.en: What is this? Can't you see me?
What am I even supposed to do...
You're not calling this a cocktail, are you?
What kind of cocktail is this...

text.ko: 시간이랑 돈 다 버렸네요, 이걸로 장사가 돼요?
text.en: Wasted my time and money. How is this place in business?

text.ko: 물 있어요? 입 헹구려고요. 뭔 이런 걸 팔고 있어...
text.en: Got water? I need to rinse my mouth. Unbelievable...
Master, I'd like to be seated.

text.ko: 아이, 나 한 잔만 걸치고 갈게. 마스터!
text.en: C'mon, just one quick drink. Master!

text.ko: 혼자 왔는데 자리 있을까요? 다리가 좀 아파서.
text.en: Alone tonight — got a seat? My legs are killing me.

text.ko: 아직도 자리 없어요? 아니, 사람을 원래 기다리게 하고 그래?
text.en: Still no seat? Do you always keep people waiting?

text.ko: 보자보자, 뭘 마시는 게 좋을까... 일단 {cocktail} 하나!
text.en: Let's see, what should I drink... one {cocktail} for now!

text.ko: 저번에 그거 괜찮았는데. {cocktail}? 그거 하나 주세요.
text.en: That one was good last time. {cocktail}? One of those.

text.ko: 아, 이거지! 맛이 좋은데요? 오늘 술이 잘 받네...
text.en: That's the stuff! Tastes great! Drinks are landing tonight...
Nothing beats this, I'm telling you. Thanks.

text.ko: 음, 오늘 컨디션이 별로인가? 맛이 이상하네...
text.en: Hm, am I off today? Tastes weird...

text.ko: 저기, 마스터? 마스터! 이거 잘못 만들었어요?
text.en: Excuse me, master? Master! Did you make this wrong?

text.ko: 이거 맛이 왜 이래?... 마스터, 제대로 만든 거 맞죠?
text.en: Why does it taste like this?... You made it right, right?

text.ko: {cocktail} 맛 괜찮아요? 궁금한데. 이거 추가로 주문할게요.
text.en: Is the {cocktail} good? I'm curious. Add that one.

text.ko: {cocktail} 이거 괜찮다고 하던데, 이거 하나 줘요.
text.en: Heard the {cocktail}'s decent — give me one.

text.ko: 감사합니다, 잘 마셨어요! 다음에도 잘 좀 부탁할게요.
text.en: Thanks, that was great! Take care of me next time too.
It's made — why aren't you serving it?
Forget it. I'm going somewhere else.

text.ko: 만들어 놓고 안 주는 건 무슨 경우야!
text.en: You made it and won't serve it?!
I knew it — this is NOT what I ordered!!
Um... this isn't spoiled, is it...?
As if I'd order anything else.
No rush. Just don't forget me.

text.ko: 이건 기사감이군. '신입 바텐더, 손님을 독살하려 들다'.
text.en: This is front-page material: 'Rookie bartender attempts poisoning.'
Hm? Is this what I ordered?
As I thought. I ordered a {cocktail}.
A fine drink. Give Chris my regards.
Let's call it an off night.
I'm out of time. A pity.
What kind of bar is this?!

text.ko: 크리스는 안에 있나? ...아, 자네한테 시키면 되지.
text.en: Is Chris in? ...Ah, never mind. I can order from you.

text.ko: 아~ 뭐 마시지? 이럴 때가 제일 행복하다니까요.
text.en: Ahh, what to drink? Honestly the best part of the night.
The music here is really nice.
Uptown's a mess these days — you heard?
Just talking to myself, don't mind me.
